facts.fact: The Unlocking Data Initiative Malawi team is developing an Education Data Portal (EDaP) to bring together datasets from the education ministry (MoEST, which runs the EMIS), the gender and social welfare ministry, the National Statistics Office, development partners and academia, with hosting to pass to CERT at the University of Malawi.

systems.owner: Unlocking Data Initiative, to pass to CERT, University of Malawi
Ministry of Education, Science and Technology

note: Date is the post's publication date, as it gives no date for the portal work.

systems.system: Education Management Information System (EMIS), with cohort tracking and Learner Identification Numbers

note: Describes fragmented, paper-based, poorly integrated systems and LINs within EMIS cohort tracking; no exchange between education systems, shared identifier or link beyond is stated.
The ISR covers a pre-primary, teacher and classroom programme and names no education data system, learner identifier or data link.

systems.platform: web-based, developed with UNICEF support; functional at national, district and school level, limited offline functionality

systems.system: Teacher deployment monitoring and reporting system

note: The compact (April 2024) describes the EMIS and a planned teacher deployment monitoring system, and says education data is fragmented, but states no link between education systems, no shared learner identifier and no link to the national ID or another sector.
